reason: The local changes are sound on the 65SC12: only real opcodes (BMI/BCC/RTS/STA abs,X), branches in range and in page &99, callers of widen_by_live (.listed: INC list_n) use neither A nor C, take_off's out label and its BEQ out are kept, list_y1 and list_y2 cannot alias so swapping their updates is safe. Recount: widen tail old y1-kept LDA4+CMP4+BCS taken 3 = 11, new LDA4+CMP4+BCC not taken 2 (+RTS shared) = 10, -1; y1-store path +1. take_off not-coming-off: BPL taken 3+RTS6 = 9 vs BMI 2+RTS 6 = 8, -1; going-on path +1 (BMI taken, same page &99). From the window's measured cycles: widen ~1.98 runs a pass (1.88 kept, 0.1 stored), take_off ~7.28 (5.24 off, 2.04 on): about -1.8 -3.2 = -5 cycles a pass, plus the two branches (&9CFC BEQ in_hazel, &9EFD BEQ gathered) that stop crossing (~-1). Bytes: +2 (widen tail 23->24, take_off head 4->5), as the candidate says. But the +2 move of everything after take_off is not fully counted: it also moves the straight sprite data in bank 4 (straight_35..straight_4b, &A530-&B29F), which draw_column reads through (d_ptr),Y with d_ptr below the data (d_ptr = col_ptr - 1 - line), plus the col_ptr/d_ptr page-carry branches (BCC on_same_page, BCS data_same_page). Walking each sprite's columns over ds_line 0..7, the +2 shift adds page-crossing reads and carry paths in straight_35 (+8 cycles over 8 lines), 3a (+17), 3c (+19), 40 (+4), 47 (+27), 48 (+19), 49 (+23), i.e. roughly +0.5 to +3.4 cycles per draw of each of these sprites, and none get faster. Also straight_sprite_hi (&A4E4, spans &A500) gains crossings for entries &1A/&1B (+1 per read in ren_draw_sprite). The candidate's relies_on checked only abs,X/Y tables and branches, not these (zp),Y sprite reads; with a few such draws a pass the cost is comparable to the ~6 cycles a pass gained, so the net is unproven and could be zero or a loss. Not sure it is right: refuted (would need passbench/fieldcost measurement of the shifted build to stand).
